keyEvents.text: Goal! Atlanta United 1, Toronto FC 0. Miguel Almirón (Atlanta United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Aleksey Miranchuk with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury Miguel Almirón (Atlanta United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Dániel Sallói (Toronto FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Atlanta United 2, Toronto FC 0. Cooper Sanchez (Atlanta United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Miguel Almirón.
